Michigan Stadium

Michigan Stadium, nicknamed "The Big House," is the football stadium for the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It is the largest stadium in the United States and the Western Hemisphere, the third-largest stadium in the world.

Crisler Center

Crisler Center, often referred to as "The House that Cazzie Built," is the basketball arena for the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It opened in 1967 and has a seating capacity of 12,707. The arena is named after Herbert O. "Fritz" Crisler, a legendary Michigan football coach and athletic director.

Yost Ice Arena

Yost Ice Arena, originally opened as Yost Field House in 1923, is the ice hockey arena for the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It has a seating capacity of 5,800 and is named after Fielding H. Yost, a renowned Michigan football coach and athletic director.
